description: This file defines an abstract interface class 'ReadAdapterInterface' in the 'caffe2::serialize' namespace, which provides methods for reading data from different sources in the context of file/stream/memory readers for PyTorchStreamReader.

classes.name: ReadAdapterInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface class for reading data sources such as files, streams, or memory in PyTorch serialization framework.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the data source.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified position into a buffer; supports optional description parameter.
